title: PU-12M lesson 3: the squad leader
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/pu12m.json: deploy_orient) and the crew data's reports (data/crew/pu12m_crew.json), with their sources
notes: The battery commander's orders are given by the lesson (on_start) at the learner's pace.

steps.title: The squad leader's seat
lines: You are the squad leader (No. 1): front right.

You orient the post: you measure which way it faces with the PAB-2 aiming circle, hold that direction with the GAK gyro, and plot the post's position with the KP-4. Every azimuth the post gives the launchers is only as good as your orientation.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The GAK's control panel
lines: At your right: the GAK, the gyro direction indicator. Once given a measured direction it holds it as the post stands.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The PAB-2 aiming circle
lines: Its case: the PAB-2, set up on its tripod outside to measure a direction from a landmark.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The KP-4 plotter
lines: Ahead of you: the KP-4 coordinate and course plotter.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The IT-1M status board
lines: And the IT-1M board: a column of lamps for each launcher, ready, on a target, launched, its missiles.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The commander: «Пункт управления развернуть!»
lines: The battery commander orders the post deployed. Your part: your radio, and the orientation.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Your R-123M on: ПИТАНИЕ
lines: Switch your R-123M (FuG-1) on: the air-picture net.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The GAK on
lines: Switch the GAK on: its gyro runs up.
steps.why: A gyro needs minutes to run up and settle: start it first.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Set up the PAB-2
lines: Set up the PAB-2 aiming circle outside: the switch stands for carrying it out, levelling it and measuring the direction from a landmark.
steps.why: The aiming circle is the post's compass: its measured direction is what the GAK will hold.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Enter the measured direction into the GAK
lines: When the GAK has run up and the direction is measured, press the GAK's button to enter it.
steps.why: From now on the GAK knows which way the post faces.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Bring the PAB-2 back in
lines: The post is oriented: bring the aiming circle back in.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The KP-4 on
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The DTP's parallax set
lines: Set the DTP's parallax: the post's offset from the reference point, for the telecode (it is low by your knee: L takes you there).
steps.hint: L: step to it.   Left click.

steps.title: Report it: «Ориентирование закончено!»
lines: Tell the commander: O, then «Ориентирование закончено!» (Post oriented!).
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: The crew deploys
lines: Your part is done. The others finish theirs.

steps.title: The squad leader's part: done
lines: That is your part: your radio on, the post oriented with the PAB-2 and the GAK, the KP-4 and the DTP set.
Esc, then M: the missions menu, and the next seat's lesson.
